summary: Acer Aspire 5 14 laptop struggles with everyday tasks due to limited processing power, insufficient RAM, and outdated storage. Upgrading the RAM and replacing the SSD with a faster storage option can improve performance.
detected_fault: Limited processing power, insufficient RAM, and outdated storage contribute to its performance issues.
suggested_solution: Upgrading the RAM to at least 16GB and replacing the SSD with a faster storage option can improve performance.
